parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the actuator or toggle part of the switch, made of ABS plastic, typically rectangular and slightly curved for finger operation.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the user interface for turning the switch on or off, transmitting mechanical motion to the internal contacts.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots or rocks back and forth around a central axis to open or close the electrical circuit.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing or base body of the switch, made of durable nylon plastic, providing structural support and insulation.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal electrical contacts and terminals, ensuring mechanical stability and electrical insulation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a fixed mount for the moving switch actuator.
